 Follow Dreaming of a white Christmas? Old Farmer's Almanac releases forecast
 Melina Khan, USA TODAY Updated Tue, November 3, 2026 at 5:50 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Dreams of a white Christmas may come true in some parts of the country, if the Old Farmer's Almanac's weather forecast is any indication.
 The Old Farmer's Almanac has released its Christmas weather forecast for 2026, and it's projecting a snowy holiday for some areas.
 A white Christmas is defined as having at least one inch of snow on the ground at 7 a.m. local time on Christmas Day, according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement While the Old Farmer's Almanac's 2026 Christmas weather outlook varies widely across the country, its forecast breaks down the likelihood for snow into three categories: white Christmas, chance of a white Christmas or not a white Christmas.
 The outlook is only a prediction. The Old Farmer's Almanac says it makes its forecasts using a formula combining solar science, climatology and meteorology.

 A Christmas decoration in Haddonfield, New Jersey, surrounded by snow on Monday, Dec. 15, 2025. The Old Farmer's Almanac's Christmas weather forecast is broken down by region. Here's a look at the predictions:
 Northeast: A white Christmas
 Atlantic Corridor: Not a white Christmas
 Appalachians: Not a white Christmas in the north; chance of a white Christmas in the south
 Southeast: Not a white Christmas
 Florida: Not a white Christmas
 Lower Lakes: Chance of a white Christmas
 Ohio Valley: Chance of a white Christmas
 Deep South: Not a white Christmas
 Upper Midwest: Not a white Christmas
 Heartland: Not a white Christmas
 Texas–Oklahoma: Not a white Christmas
 High Plains: Chance of a white Christmas
 Intermountain: A white Christmas
 Desert Southwest: Not a white Christmas
 Pacific Northwest: Chance of a white Christmas
 Pacific Southwest: Not a white Christmas
 Alaska: A white Christmas
 Hawaii: Not a white Christmas
 More Old Farmer's Almanac winter weather forecasts
 The publication also released a long-range forecast for winter this year.
 Advertisement Advertisement It's predicting mostly mild temperatures across the country, with a colder stretch from central New England through the Appalachians and Ohio Valley.
 The Old Farmer's Almanac is also predicting wetter conditions than normal across much of the west and in parts of the south and midwest.
 As for snow, the publication predicted more in parts of the northeast and Appalachians, plus parts of the west and Alaska.
